text: Sarah J. Maas's A Court of Frost and Starlight was ordered removed from every public school in Utah by the state school board under a new law. A Charlotte-Mecklenburg panel voted to remove it from all CMS schools because it decided the book's literary merit did not offset its sexual content. By October 2025, it had also been removed from all South Carolina public school classrooms and libraries under Regulation 43-170.
